name: tooltip
source: src/components/_base-tooltip.vue (Floto override; kit MTooltip excluded). Renders via VTippy (vue-tippy).
summary: Transient hover/focus label anchored to a trigger. The kit MTooltip is excluded and this Floto override ships instead, rendering through VTippy (not a-tooltip). trigger slot = anchor, default slot = content. Non-interactive — for interactive panels use Popover.

siblingMechanisms.graph/canvas tooltips: topology/netroute/apm edge & node tooltips — domain-specific content, not MTooltip

disabled.note: short-circuits — renders the trigger inline with no tooltip

trigger.note: DECLARED BUT NOT WIRED to VTippy (F1) — VTippy uses its own hover default

slots.trigger: the anchor element (e.g. an info-circle icon)

decisionFlow: Is the content interactive (buttons, inputs, links)? -> use Popover, NOT a tooltip.
Just the full text of a truncated/plain element? -> native title='' attribute (browser tooltip, ~59x).
A styled/rich/positioned hint on hover/focus? -> MTooltip (the 94x default).
Is it a chart/series hover card? -> MTooltip with overlay-class-name='chart-like-tooltip'.
A topology/graph edge or node tooltip? -> domain-specific graph tooltip component, NOT MTooltip.
Should the hint be conditionally suppressed? -> :disabled='true'.

infoHint.useWhen: explain a field/icon with a short text hint
infoHint.how: info-circle in the trigger slot + text in the default slot
infoHint.example: Polling interval ⓘ -> 'How often the monitor is polled.'

richHover.useWhen: a small non-interactive hover card (title + a few key/values)
richHover.how: structured content in the default slot

default.useWhen: You need the standard dark hover/focus bubble for a short, non-interactive hint — most commonly the info-circle idiom: an info-circle MIcon in the trigger slot with explanatory text in the default slot. This is the 94x workhorse (73x use the top-start default placement). Also covers the rich hover card: a small non-interactive title + a few key/values in the default slot.
default.dontUse: Don't use for content with buttons/links/inputs (it dismisses on mouse-out — use Popover instead). Don't use for the full text of a plain/truncated cell or label (use the native title='' attribute, ~59x, cheaper with no component). Switch to chart-like-tooltip when the hint must match a chart/graph surface (light bubble). Not for topology/graph edge or node tooltips (domain-specific graph components).
default.example: The 'Polling interval ⓘ' field hint on settings/monitor forms — info-circle trigger revealing 'How often the monitor is polled.' Also the topology/host hover card (title + a few key/values, placement=right) shown in the Rich content story.

chart-like-tooltip.useWhen: The tooltip should visually match a chart/graph surface — a LIGHT bubble (--chart-tooltip-background + page text) instead of the default dark one. Apply overlay-class-name='chart-like-tooltip'. Used for series/point hovers and info-tooltips that live on a chart canvas.
chart-like-tooltip.dontUse: Don't use for ordinary UI field hints — the default dark bubble is correct there. Don't use for actual chart data-series hover cards rendered by the Highcharts chart layer (those are the chart TooltipBuilder / sparkline / heatmap tooltips, owned by the chart component, not MTooltip). Only 2x in the product, so reach for it deliberately.
chart-like-tooltip.example: The traceroute Timeout info-tooltip (via tooltip-props with overlay-class-name='chart-like-tooltip'), giving a light chart-surface bubble on the traceroute chart.

placements.useWhen: You need to steer where the bubble opens relative to the trigger via the `placement` prop (VTippy names: top-start default, top, top-end, bottom, bottom-start, left, right, plus -start/-end). Set it when layout constraints require the bubble to avoid clipping or overlapping neighbours — e.g. right for a rich card next to a node, left/bottom near panel edges.
placements.dontUse: Don't change placement just for style — top-start dominates (73x) and should stay the default unless the layout forces it. Don't use Ant placement names here (bottomLeft) — those belong to MPopover and are NOT interchangeable with VTippy names. Rare placements (bottomRight/topLeft/right) are 1-2x, so only override when genuinely needed.
placements.example: The Rich content host hover-card in topology uses placement='right' so the card opens beside the node; the Placements story stacks top-start/top/left/right/bottom/bottomRight/topLeft to show directional layout.

do: Use the info-circle idiom for field hints
Use :disabled when the hint is redundant
dont: Don't put buttons/links/inputs in a tooltip (it dismisses on mouse-out) — use Popover
Don't rely on the `trigger` prop to change activation (it's not wired — F1)

F1.issue: `trigger` prop declared (default 'hover focus') but not passed to VTippy — changing it has no effect.

F2.issue: No focus ring on the overlay (`:focus { outline:none }` in _base-popper) — links to SF-001.

F3.issue: Tooltip content is not linked to the trigger via aria-describedby; icon-only triggers have no accessible name — screen-reader users may miss the hint.

events: none — VTippy (vue-tippy) driven; the wrapper emits no Vue events. Control visibility via the `disabled` / `trigger` props.

a11y.summary: Appears on focus + hover (keyboard-reachable if the trigger is focusable). Keep the trigger ≥24px.
issues: Icon-only triggers often aren't focusable / have no name.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
